author: TheChosenGuy1
body:
When appealing for a temp-ban/ban on the Avicus Network please include the following: 
  • Your minecraft username(most recent name if changed) TheChosenGuy1
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned I have no clue. 
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server. I did nothing?

    My reason i was banned says another player's name who's on the same IP as I am. Who was unbanned yesterday for a flase ban in the first place. I guess they though I was an alt or banned same IP. It says "Ban Evasion" - Soccermaster89 but That's not even me so why Am I banned? No reason at all. Sr mod Midnightbeats is at fault
